operation_details.item: The user completed the baseline data collection for the telecom diagnostic.

conversation.message: How’s the telecom diagnostic coming along today?

conversation.message: Pretty well. I completed the baseline data collection, so we finally have something solid to work from.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice, that should make the next conversations much easier. Is the interview schedule still set?

conversation.message: Yes, the interview schedule is set. I’m trying not to over-engineer it, though—I’d rather let the conversations surface what matters.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds sensible. How’s the hypothesis tree progressing?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The hypothesis tree is in progress, and we have a synthesis workshop planned for next week. I’ll use the new baseline findings to keep the discussion grounded without turning it into a slide exercise.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I completed the baseline data collection; keep the interview schedule, hypothesis tree, and synthesis workshop.
